name: App API (capability runtime + encrypted token store)
purpose: runs the app-api capability pipeline locally on PowOS: the encrypted token store, the runtime call path (safety enforcement + handle-injected auth + audit), the `powos app` CLI, the AI tools and widget bindings. Offline/LAN-only; no Mac or cloud at runtime. Design: docs/APP-API-CAPTURE.md.
installedBy: targets/android/build-pkgs.sh (app-api) + powos-deploy.sh; also installable on desktop PowOS

limits.network: lan-only; no outbound except to apps the user has explicitly enabled

remove.note: the state dir holds the encrypted token store + audit log; removal keeps it by default so re-install is seamless. Delete ~/.local/state/powos/app-api manually to wipe stored sessions.
